Callout.Name: Counter-Surveillance - Watched Office
Callout.Message: Person repeatedly seen watching an office.
Callout.Advisory: One suspect, parked up, camera to hand.

Script.Line: I am a photographer. Buildings are what I photograph.
It is a public pavement and I can put a camera on it.
Look at the card. There is a building on every frame.

Lines.Approach: Same corner four days running with a camera. That is not tourism.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
